BhvCertificering.title: BHV certification
BhvCertificering.description: A bedrijfshulpverlening (BHV) related certification held by one employee: a plain dated fact (certificate obtained, certificate valid until), not a workflow. A renewal after a herhalingscursus is recorded as a NEW BhvCertificering object with a later certificaatBehaaldOp/certificaatGeldigTot pair -- the original record is left unmodified (bhv-organisatie design.md D4). No x-openregister-lifecycle. Certificate-expiry signalling reuses the existing hr-signals mechanism (nl-bhv-certificaat-verloopt, lib/Standards/Checks/NlSignalChecks.php) rather than a new alerting mechanism, and this schema/its pages assert NO numeric BHV-coverage ratio -- Arbeidsomstandighedenwet art. 15 sets a qualitative, RI&E-driven adequacy standard, not a fixed number (bhv-organisatie proposal.md Why).

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: UUID reference to the Employee holding this BHV-related certification.

rol.title: Role
rol.description: The BHV-related role this certification covers. Enum append-only: renaming a value later is breaking, adding one is not.

certificaatGeldigTot.title: Certificate valid until
certificaatGeldigTot.description: Date the certification expires (ISO 8601) -- the expiry-alert anchor read by nl-bhv-certificaat-verloopt (lib/Standards/Checks/NlSignalChecks.php, framework hr-signals, parameters.windowDays=90).

opleider.title: Training provider
opleider.description: Name of the training provider (opleidingsinstituut) that issued the certification, when known.

orgUnitId.title: Organisational unit
orgUnitId.description: UUID reference to the OrgUnit this certification's coverage is grouped/visible under (the coverage-visibility scoping concept, bhv-organisatie design.md D3 -- deliberately NOT a physical Location, which hrmq's register does not model). Null when the certification is not scoped to a specific unit.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this BhvCertificering is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7); maintained by HR/back-office when the record is created.
